worked_solution:
Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}24(z-1)\,\text{d}V={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{2x-y}24(z-1)\,dz\,dy\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{2x-y}24(z-1)\,dz\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}[{\int }_{0}^{2x-y}24(z-1)\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}[12{z}^{2}-24z]_{z=0}^{z=2x-y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}(12(2x-y)^{2}-24(2x-y))\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}12(4{x}^{2}-4xy+{y}^{2}-4x+2y)\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}12(4{x}^{2}-4xy+{y}^{2}-4x+2y)\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{x}48({x}^{2}-x)+24(1-2x)y+12{y}^{2}\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[48({x}^{2}-x)y+12(1-2x){y}^{2}+4{y}^{3}]_{y=0}^{y=x}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}48({x}^{2}-x)x+12(1-2x){x}^{2}+4{x}^{3}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}28{x}^{3}-36{x}^{2}\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}28{x}^{3}-36{x}^{2}\,dx & ={[7{x}^{4}-12{x}^{3}]}_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =(112-96)-(7-12) \\  & =21.\end{aligned}
$$

Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

∭R24(z−1)dV=∫12∫0x∫02x−y24(z−1)dzdydx.

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to z, treating x and y as constants:

∫12∫0x∫02x−y24(z−1)dzdydx=∫12∫0x[∫02x−y24(z−1)dz]dydx=∫12∫0x[12z2−24z]z=0z=2x−ydydx=∫12∫0x(12(2x−y)2−24(2x−y))dydx=∫12∫0x12(4x2−4xy+y2−4x+2y)dydx

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to y, treating x as a constant:

∫12∫0x12(4x2−4xy+y2−4x+2y)dydx=∫12[∫0x48(x2−x)+24(1−2x)y+12y2dy]dx=∫12[48(x2−x)y+12(1−2x)y2+4y3]y=0y=xdx=∫1248(x2−x)x+12(1−2x)x2+4x3dx=∫1228x3−36x2dx

Finally, we integrate with respect to x:

∫1228x3−36x2dx=[7x4−12x3]x=1x=2=(112−96)−(7−12)=21.
